verdict.rationale: Dropbox's own Dash product is documented as giving 'clear answers' from team knowledge, and Dash resources describe AI answers, document insights, summarization, AI review and AI file organization (docs-11, docs-34, docs-33, docs-36, docs-35, docs-37). However, the main Dropbox homepage says 'AI is coming to Dropbox' (docs-49), which suggests these capabilities may sit in Dash rather than core Dropbox or are still rolling out. The evidence is mostly marketing-resource titles rather than feature documentation. missing for 10: in-depth first-party feature docs, clear evidence of proactive suggestions (not just answers or summaries), confirmation it is generally available inside core Dropbox, independent or hands-on corroboration.
